name: Blue Grotto Caves
description: The sea caves of the Blue Grotto below the cliffs east of Wied iż-Żurrieq: several caverns to explore in shallow water, lit by the famous blue light. Usually reached by boat; from the shore entry in the valley it's a swim of around 40 minutes.
conditions: Lots of tourist boats in and out of the caves. Being shallow and open, the site gets rough in any swell.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
